source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This landing removes only the count attribute and its getter. Copy destinations remain in the stored list, with append, serialization and GetCopyDestination still present; the inspected playback consumer reads index zero. Scoped text searches find no direct count-getter caller before removal and no retained reference afterward. Later accepted comments explicitly leave multiple-copy behavior uncertain. This does not change the stored format or establish generated-interface compatibility, external callers or successful IMAP playback.
title: Removing numberOfCopies leaves copy-destination storage and indexed lookup in place
